---
title: "BMRG abundance and correlation analysis"
---

```{r}
library(rio)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggthemes)
library(forcats)
```

```{r}
input_dir <- "../../demo_data/BMRG_abundance_and_correlation"
output_dir <- "../../demo_run/BMRG_abundance_and_correlation"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

reads_args <- import(file.path(input_dir, "known_ARG_abundance.tsv"))
struct_file <- import(file.path(input_dir, "SARG_structure.tsv"))
high_risk <- import(file.path(input_dir, "rank_I_ARGs.tsv"))
bac_abundance <- import(file.path(input_dir, "BMRG_abundance.tsv"))
bac_structure <- import(file.path(input_dir, "BacMet_structure.tsv"))

bmrg_display_threshold <- 0.7
```

```{r}
fg <- reads_args |>
  inner_join(struct_file, join_by(gene == SARG.Seq.ID)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(".reads.qc"),
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  separate_wider_delim(
    sample,
    delim = "-",
    names = c("city", "method", "dna", "pool", "month", "year"),
    cols_remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, 1, 4),
         ngroup = str_c(city,"-", method),
         ngroup_pool = str_c(city,"-", method, "-", pool),
         'dna' = NULL,
         time = str_c(year,"–", month)) |>
  filter(Type != 'multidrug')

datr1 <- fg |>
  semi_join(high_risk, join_by(gene == Variant)) |>
  group_by(ngroup, ngroup_pool, time) |>
  summarise(
    type_value = sum(value), .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(ngroup, time) |>
  summarise(
    ave_value = mean(type_value), .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(time_date = as.Date(paste0(time, "–01"), format = "%Y–%m–%d"))
```

```{r}
# Prepare BMRG abundance data
bac <- bac_abundance |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(".reads.qc"),
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  separate_wider_delim(
    level1,
    delim = "|",
    names = c("BacMet_ID", "B2", "B3", "B4", "B5"),
    cols_remove = FALSE,
    too_few = "align_start"
  ) |>
  replace_na(list(value = 0))

# Prepare BacMet annotations
# Identify BacMet IDs associated with multiple gene annotations
duplicated_bacmet_ids <- bac_structure |>
  distinct(BacMet_ID, Gene_name) |>
  count(BacMet_ID) |>
  filter(n > 1) |>
  pull(BacMet_ID)
# Match IDs with multiple gene annotations by both BacMet ID and gene name
b1 <- bac |>
  filter(BacMet_ID %in% duplicated_bacmet_ids) |>
  inner_join(bac_structure, join_by(BacMet_ID, B2 == Gene_name)) |>
  mutate(Gene_name = B2) |>
  relocate(Gene_name, .after = "value")
# Match uniquely annotated IDs by BacMet ID
b2 <- bac |>
  filter(!BacMet_ID %in% duplicated_bacmet_ids) |>
  inner_join(bac_structure, join_by(BacMet_ID))
b3 <- rbind(b1, b2)
```

```{r}
bg <- b3 |>
  separate_wider_delim(
    sample,
    delim = "-",
    names = c("city", "method", "dna", "pool", "month", "year"),
    cols_remove = FALSE
  ) |>
  mutate(year = str_sub(year, 1, 4),
         ngroup = str_c(city,"-", method),
         ngroup_pool = str_c(city,"-", method, "-", pool),
         'dna' = NULL,
         time = str_c(year,"–", month))
```

# Total BMRG abundance
```{r}
my_color_industry <- c("MM-ED" = "#c38100", "MM-HC" = "darkred", "ZH-HC" = "darkred", "ZH-ED" = "#c38100")
datc <- bg |>
  group_by(ngroup, ngroup_pool, time) |>
  summarise(
    type_value = sum(value), .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(ngroup, time) |>
  summarise(
    ave_value = mean(type_value), .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(time_date = as.Date(paste0(time, "–01"), format = "%Y–%m–%d"))

datm2 <- datc |>
  filter(ngroup == "MM-ED" | ngroup == "MM-HC")
datz2 <- datc |>
  filter(ngroup == "ZH-ED" | ngroup == "ZH-HC")

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = datm2, aes(x = time_date, y = ave_value, color = ngroup)) +
  geom_point(data = datm2, aes(x = time_date, y = ave_value, color = ngroup)) +
  geom_line(data = datz2, aes(x = time_date, y = ave_value, color = ngroup), linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(data = datz2, aes(x = time_date, y = ave_value, color = ngroup), shape = 4) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%Y–%m", date_breaks = "1 month") +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_color_industry) +
  theme_few() +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "BMRGs copy number (copies/cell)")

ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "BMRG_total_abundance.svg"), device = "svg", width = 17, height = 11, units = "cm")
```

# Group comparisons of BMRG abundance
```{r}
dat_plot <- bg |>
  group_by(ngroup, pool, time) |>
  summarise(type_value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(
    region = sub("-.*", "", ngroup),   
    status = sub(".*-", "", ngroup)   
  )
my_colors <- c("A" = "#5C7A77", "O" = "#847195")
compare_status <- list(c("ED", "HC"))

ggplot(dat_plot, aes(x = status, y = type_value, color = pool)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, size = 0.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(color = pool), 
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, seed = 123), 
             size = 1.2, alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_compare_means(
   aes(group = pool),
   label = "p.signif", 
   method = "wilcox.test",
   label.y = max(dat_plot$type_value) * 1.05, 
   size = 3.5,
   vjust = -0.5,               
   show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = compare_status,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.format",
    bracket.size = 0.6,
    label.y = max(dat_plot$type_value) * 1.2,  
    tip.length = 0.03,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~region) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA), 
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
    text = element_text(family = "Arial")
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "BMRGs copy number (copies/cell)", color = "Tank")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "BMRG_abundance_group_comparisons.svg"), device = "svg", width = 15, height = 9, units = "cm")
```

# BMRG composition
```{r}
colors_bac <- c(
  "Others" = "#E0E0E0",           
  "As" = "#4A6FA5",               
  "Cd,Zn,Co" = "#166088",         
  "CTM" = "#DB7F67",              
  "Cr" = "#62929E",               
  "Cr,CPC,DDN,2-NID" = "#544766", 
  "Cr,Te,Se" = "#829399",         
  "Cu" = "#B388EB",               
  "HCl,NaOH" = "#F4A261",         
  "Fe" = "#DDA15E",               
  "Fe,H2O2" = "#9B2226",          
  "Pb" = "#606C38",               
  "Hg" = "#A8A878"                
)

ke <- bg |>
  group_by(Compound) |>
  summarise(type_value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Type_others = if_else(type_value > bmrg_display_threshold, Compound, 'Others'),
         Type_others = str_remove_all(Type_others, "\\s*\\[.*?\\]"),
         Type_others = str_remove_all(Type_others, "[^,()]+ \\("),
         Type_others = str_remove_all(Type_others, "\\)"),
         Type_others = str_replace_all(Type_others, ",\\s+", ",")) |>
  mutate(Type_others = str_replace_all(Type_others, "2-nitroimidazole", "2-NID"),
         Type_others = str_replace_all(Type_others, "Dodine", "DDN")) |>
  select(Compound, Type_others)
dato_ave2 <- bg |>
  left_join(ke, join_by(Compound)) |>
  group_by(time, ngroup, ngroup_pool, Type_others) |>
  summarise(type_value = sum(value), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(time_date = as.Date(paste0(time, "–01"), format = "%Y–%m–%d"),
         year_month = format(time_date, "%Y-%m"),
         year_month = fct_reorder(year_month, time_date)) |>
  group_by(year_month, ngroup, Type_others) |>
  summarize(ave_type_value = mean(type_value), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(year_month, ngroup) |>
  mutate(pct = ave_type_value / sum(ave_type_value)) |>
  ungroup()
dato_ave2 <- dato_ave2 |> 
  mutate(Type_others = factor(Type_others),
         Type_others = fct_relevel(Type_others, "Others", after = 0))

ggplot(dato_ave2, aes(x = year_month, y = pct, fill = Type_others)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ ngroup, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_bac) +
    scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25), 
    labels = function(x) paste0(x * 100),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  theme_few() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Relative abundance (%)",
    fill = "BMRG Category"
  ) +
    theme(
    text = element_text(family = "Arial"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15),  
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),   
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 15),    
    panel.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "lines"),   
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "white", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5) 
  )
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "BMRG_composition.svg"), device = "svg", width = 33, height = 16, units = "cm")
```

# Correlation between BMRG and total ARG abundance
```{r}
dat1 <- fg |>
  group_by(ngroup, ngroup_pool, time) |>
  summarise(
    type_value = sum(value), .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(ngroup, time) |>
  summarise(
    ave_value = mean(type_value), .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(time_date = as.Date(paste0(time, "–01"), format = "%Y–%m–%d"))
dat3 <- dat1 |>
  left_join(datc, join_by(ngroup, time, time_date)) |>
  rename("args" = ave_value.x, "bmrgs" = ave_value.y) |>
    separate_wider_delim(
    ngroup,
    delim = "-",
    names = c("city", "method"),
    cols_remove = FALSE
  )

ggplot(dat3, aes(x = bmrgs, y = args)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = city, color = method), size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) + 
  stat_cor(
    aes(label = paste0("italic(r)~`=`~", after_stat(r), "~`,`~italic(P)~`=`~", after_stat(p))),
    method = "pearson",
    label.x.npc = "left",
    label.y.npc = "top"
  ) +
  theme_few() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("ED" = "#c38100", "HC" = "darkred")) +
  labs(x = "BMRGs copy number (copies/cell)", y = "ARGs copy number (copies/cell)", shape = "City", color = "Method")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "BMRG_total_ARG_correlation.svg"), device = "svg", width = 17, height = 8, units = "cm")
```

# Correlation between BMRG and Rank I ARG abundance
```{r}
datr3 <- datr1 |>
  left_join(datc, join_by(ngroup, time, time_date)) |>
  rename("args" = ave_value.x, "bmrgs" = ave_value.y) |>
    separate_wider_delim(
    ngroup,
    delim = "-",
    names = c("city", "method"),
    cols_remove = FALSE
  )

ggplot(datr3, aes(x = bmrgs, y = args * 1000)) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = city, color = method), size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.3, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) + 
  stat_cor(
    aes(label = paste0("italic(r)~`=`~", after_stat(r), "~`,`~italic(P)~`=`~", after_stat(p))),
    method = "pearson",
    label.x.npc = "left",
    label.y.npc = "top"
  ) +
  theme_few() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("ED" = "#c38100", "HC" = "darkred")) +
  labs(x = "BMRGs copy number (copies/cell)", y = "Rank I ARGs copy number\n(copies/1,000 cells)", shape = "City", color = "Method")
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "BMRG_rank_I_ARG_correlation.svg"), device = "svg", width = 17, height = 8, units = "cm")
```
